risk_note: RV2 (ledger module, read only; D10-1049 ③, D10-1050 ②, D10-1057, D10-1079). Implements the CT-24zzc operations: ledger/http/admin/user-fund.controller.ts (permission fund.view or user.lookup, readOnly, no-store, contract route schemas), application / infra admin-ledger-read (one read-only REPEATABLE READ transaction per answer). Summary: available_fen / frozen_fen / negative_since from the account_balances cache row (no account row → 0 / 0 / null), withdrawn_fen through payout's paid-withdrawal total (amount_fen of PAID_API / PAID_MANUAL, BR-FUND-18), withdraw_block from active withdraw_holds judged on the injected Clock (kinds only). Ledger: the user's USER_BALANCE entries of both sub-accounts joined to their vouchers, booked_at desc, id desc, amount in the user's sign (subFen(0n, x), as listWalletLedger), link mapped from biz_type, six filters and page / page_size / total. Neither answer reads or carries memo / operator / note / reject_note / source_ref / created_by (D10-1057 ①), so both permissions get the same answer. Per D10-1079 the two operations drop x-implementation: planned (openapi.yaml and regenerated files in this task's paths). Built on CT-24zzc. The brief was written by hand because BR-FUND-13/15/16/18 exceed 24 KB (BR-FUND-15 / 16 main rows only). Host: tsc 0, apps/api unit tests 88, non-integration rule tests 24; integration rule tests 17 / 17 on the host in the local container slot; full verification is the required CI checks (approvals #21).
